quiz.name: Informed Consent Form
quiz.intro: Please read the information here and consent to participate in the study.

question_attempt.questionsummary:
INFORMED CONSENT
1. PURPOSE
This study explores how students use STACK, an online tool for mathematics. We aim to learn about your expectations, motivation, and ideas for improving learning.
2. WHAT YOU WILL DO
You will complete a short survey (15–30 minutes). You may also join a focus group (45–60 minutes). Researchers will use _anonymized_ STACK activity and exam data.
3. VOLUNTARY PARTICIPATION
Participation is VOLUNTARY. You can stop at any time without penalty.
4. RISKS & BENEFITS
Risks are minimal, and you may skip any question. Your feedback will help improve digital assessment in African universities.
5. CONFIDENTIALITY
Your responses will remain confidential. No names or personal details will appear in reports.
-------------------------
Please confirm if you agree or do not agree to take part in this study.
BY SELECTING BELOW, YOU CONFIRM THAT:
You have read the above information, you understand that participation is voluntary, and you may withdraw at any time without penalty.
Consent to Participate: : I do not agree to take part in this study.; I have carefully read the above information and voluntarily agree to take part in this study.
question_attempt.rightanswer: I have carefully read the above information and voluntarily agree to take part in this study.
